source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Types of Polymorphism with Figure 3.6 (PDF 43, printed 39).

blocks.text: Polymorphism ka matlab hai ke aik hi method ya operation object ya halaat ke mutabiq mukhtalif behaviour kare. Is ki do bari qismein hain: compile-time aur runtime polymorphism (Figure 3.6).

blocks.alt: Polymorphism ka shajra: Polymorphism se do shakhein: Compile-time Polymorphism jo Method Overloading tak jati hai, aur Runtime Polymorphism jo Method Overriding tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6: Aik hi function ka mukhtalif bartao, polymorphism ki misal (kitab ki Figure 3.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 3.6 polymorphism ki do shaakhein dikhati hai: compile-time polymorphism, jo method overloading (ek naam, mukhtalif arguments) se hoti hai, aur runtime polymorphism, jo method overriding (child class parent ka method dobara likhti hai) se hoti hai. Agle do lessons dono ko misal ke saath samjhate hain.
